apis.ecosystem: bounded system telemetry over caller-supplied snapshots
apis.delta: Supported through Rust Component and public Host-SDK consumers. Caller supplies bounded complete snapshots and monotonic time. First/reset/no-progress CPU rate is absent; errors commit no state. Direct WAsmC source sampler-resource consumption is not qualified in v0.0.1.
64-byte little-endian successor; flags bit0 means CPU unavailable. Not the old flags-zero frame-v2 protocol.
